mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) following a 3-month FEDFUNDS decline or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over the past 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting investors to shift to defensive assets and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for 3 consecutive months or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities as corporate earnings prospects weaken, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS decline over the prior 3 months or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy approaches a slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the year-over-year CPI inflation above 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a labor market contraction, causing reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth prospects weaken.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both PAYEMS and UNRATE decline over the prior 3 months or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market boom, a surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2000 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and rising disposable income, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings benefit from increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during housing market boom periods when HOUST exceeds 2000 thousand units or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy expands.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO increases over the prior 3 months or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
